Name: Chibi Female Farmer
Author: hwamei
Description:
Optional files include a basic Fashion Sense pack containing dyeable farmer pants and overall shirts from the vanilla game that have been altered to fit the chibi base. 

Configurable Options:
[list]
[*]Chibi base can be turned on and off
[*]Farmer’s nose can be removed
[*]Farmer’s shoes can be removed
[*]3 sleeve options: none, short, long
[*]Farmer’s shadow can be trimmed to better suit the chibi base
[/list]Notes:
[list]
[*]Vanilla pants and shirts will not fit properly on the chibi base, so custom clothing is required. 
[*]Because of the chibi base’s shortened arms, animations involving tools and weapons will look off from some angles. 
[/list]
Please feel free to upload custom clothing mods for this base, and please let me know if you run into any issues! Thank you! :)

Downloads.Description: Adds chibi female farmer base. Does not contain clothing; see optional files for a basic FS pack.
